mapper.sql: SELECT d.datasource_id, d.datasource_code, d.datasource_name, d.usage_scope, d.is_enabled, d.readonly, d.allow_runtime_write, CASE WHEN g.datasource_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS granted FROM gen_datasource d LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_datasource_grant g ON g.datasource_id = d.datasource_id AND g.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_tenant_datasource_grant (tenant_id, datasource_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{datasourceId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE granted_by = VALUES(granted_by), granted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_tenant_datasource_grant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND datasource_id = #{datasourceId}
